rules.rule: PHP 8.3, PSR-12. Do not report anything PHPStan level 8, Psalm or PHP_CodeSniffer already enforce: types, unused code, style. Focus on SQL built by string concatenation, unvalidated input reaching queries or shell, null dereference on optional results, transaction boundaries, and exceptions swallowed without logging.
Flag dependencies pinned to dev-master or wildcard versions, and abandoned packages if the diff shows them being added.
